Our Story

Some love stories are written slowly, one quiet moment at a time. Ours began with a single glance and grew into a bond we never wanted to let go of. Through every shared laugh, every dream whispered late at night, and every step taken side by side, we found a home in one another. On this day, surrounded by the people we love most, Ahmed & Fadwa begin their forever — and there is no joy greater than sharing it with you. Two hearts, one promise, a lifetime of love.
